title: Sync Ported
description: This mod provides clones, or as we like to call it, “shells”. These shells are basically a new individual, with their own inventory, experience level, and even gamemode.

![Sync Logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zf-development/Sync-Forge/main/media/logo.png)

# Sync - Create Multiple Bodies, One Mind
**Ever wanted to be in two places at once? Now you can.**

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/zf-development/Sync-Forge?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/zf-development/Sync-Forge)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/zf-development/Sync-Forge/blob/main/LICENSE)

---

## What is Sync?
Sync enables you to create **shells** - physical clones of yourself with independent inventories, experience levels, and gamemodes. Transfer your consciousness between shells instantly across any dimension.

Originally created by **iChun**, this NeoForge port brings the beloved mod to modern Minecraft while preserving all its unique features.

---

## ✨ Features
- **Multiple Bodies** - Create and maintain several shells across your world
- **Cross-Dimensional Travel** - Instantly transfer between shells in different dimensions
- **Death Insurance** - When a shell dies, return to another shell instead of respawning
- **Individual Stats** - Each shell has its own inventory, XP, and gamemode
- **Biometric Lock** - Shells are tied to their creator
- **Automation Support** - Use hoppers for automatic shell equipment management
- **Color Coding** - Organize shells with dyes
- **Energy System** - Powered by adorable animals on treadmills (piggawatts!)
- **Highly Configurable** - Customize every aspect via config

---

## 🎮 Quick Start

### 1. Create a Shell Constructor
Craft a Shell Constructor and right-click it to provide a genetic sample.

⚠️ **Warning:** Default config costs 20 HP (40 HP in Hardcore). Use golden apples or totems!

### 2. Generate Energy
Place a Treadmill adjacent to the Shell Constructor and lure a pig or wolf onto it.

![Shell Constructor Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zf-development/Sync-Forge/main/media/shell_constructor-showcase.png)

### 3. Build Shell Storage
Craft a Shell Storage, power it (redstone or energy), and walk inside when doors open.

### 4. Transfer Minds
Use the radial menu to select and transfer into your desired shell!

![Sync Menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zf-development/Sync-Forge/main/media/menu-showcase.png)

---

## 💡 Pro Tips
- **Organization**: Color-code Shell Storages with dye
- **Monitoring**: Use comparators to track construction progress
- **Safety**: Mine Shell blocks with Silk Touch only
- **Automation**: Connect hoppers to shells for inventory management
- **Power**: Shell Storages need constant power (configurable)
- **Dimensions**: Works with custom dimensions!

---

## ⚙️ Crafting
All recipes are included in-game via JEI/REI. Key items:

- **Sync Core** - Central component (requires Lapis Block, Ender Pearl, Redstone Block, etc.)
- **Shell Constructor** - For creating shells
- **Shell Storage** - For storing and transferring between shells
- **Treadmill** - Energy generation (animal-powered!)

View full recipes [on GitHub](https://github.com/zf-development/Sync-Forge#crafting-recipes).

---

## 🔧 Configuration
Highly customizable via `config/sync-common.toml`:

- Adjust genetic sample damage
- Configure energy costs and generation
- Set shell death priority (nearest, natural, by color)
- Enable creative instant construction
- Customize shell lifespan settings
- Change required items for shell construction
- And much more!

---

## 📋 Requirements
- **Minecraft**: 1.20.1
- **NeoForge**: 1.20.1 or higher

---

## 🐛 Known Issues
- Dynamic shell texturing doesn't work with Iris shaders
